title: The Latest Crier for Sep 24, 2026
items:
Intramural Flag Football Sign-Ups EXTENDED

Intramural Flag Football sign-ups have been extended! If you missed the original deadline, you still have time to get a team together and sign up. The new deadline will be September 27. 
Plus, Pickleball and Sand Volleyball sign-ups are now open! Make sure to get your teams together and sign up for those! 

Use our Linktree to take you to our hub for sign-ups: https://linktr.ee/centralcollegeim

Deadline Extended!

Show your school spirit by decorating a window for homecoming! Sign up on your own or with up to 9 of your friends! We'll supply the red, white, and black paint, plus the brushes. All groups will be entered to win a $50 gift card, but the top prize is $100! Sign up here by 9/25 at noon to enter. Windows will be judged on 10/2. See your area coordinator for more info on the judging criteria!
